description: This file is a C header defining exported API functions for the System Repository Folder Object within the BroadWay Runtime System Environment. It contains function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling objects, and initializing the repository folder object, along with licensing and module documentation.

methods.name: SysCreateRepositoryFolder
methods.description: Creates a new repository folder object with specified container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: SysRfoCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the System Repository Folder object with given contexts.

methods.name: SysRfoRemove
methods.description: Removes the specified repository folder object.

methods.name: SysRfoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the repository folder object.
